description: This file sets up and runs a conversational bot pipeline using various speech and language processing services, including local CoreML turn analysis, speech-to-text, text-to-speech, and large language models, with transport mechanisms and event handlers.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the sequence of processing steps for the bot.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Handles execution and control flow of the pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline with its parameters and execution settings.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Manages the context for the language model interactions.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Pairs context with user parameters for aggregation.

classes.name: FastAPIWebsocketParams
classes.description: Transport parameters for WebSocket via FastAPI.

classes.name: TurnAnalyzerUserTurnStopStrategy
classes.description: Strategy for stopping user turns based on turn analysis.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the bot pipeline with specified transport and arguments.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point for the bot, initializes transport and starts the pipeline.
